### Two-way counter-proof
- "Just cancel" excluded: the two prerequisite sentences + records (unrefunded removed card fee; in-year claim request without a downgrade difference refund entry).
- Refund the downgrade difference without confirming the claim: excluded by D's own sentence (tier still Business Plus, claim not confirmed).
- Deduct the year's Annual Reward on cancellation: excluded once the tier is Business (refund_terms_schedule).
- Use the duplicate renewal d929c780 as the booking charge: excluded — it is the repeated charge refunded as duplicate (membership_fee_charging_rules Standard 5).
- Book the guarantee refund on the completed year's renewal 0bc80d06: excluded — that charge was 65.00 (base fee); the Plus premium for that year was paid by the upgrade difference charge.
- Count three add-on cards in use for the uplift: excluded — Dashiell's card has a later deactivation.
- Fall-backs: G 35.72 vs 23.60; D 65.00 vs 41.54; R 65.00 vs 47.34; C 195.00 (all fall-backs) / 236.12 vs 172.49 — each definite and different.
